text.tspan: Verified load-shift at D16, December 2025: day-ahead forecasts (issued 09:00 the day before)
Purple: median and bands, q05-q95 (dark) and q01-q99 (light). Orange: observed power.
Black dashed: the normal running arrangement. Grey shade: the load-shift.
